subject.title: feat: MCP Apps (ui://) Phase 0 — generic host in Control UI + plugin-declared MCP servers

question: Should native plugins attach MCP servers through the static `mcpServers` manifest field, or should that API be split from the generic MCP Apps host?
rationale: The field creates a permanent public plugin/config contract and overlaps a closed-unmerged typed runtime registration design, so implementation correctness cannot settle the ownership choice.

options.title: Approve static declarations
options.body: Keep `mcpServers` with canonical validation, deterministic precedence, disable semantics, documentation, and fresh-install and upgrade compatibility tests.

options.title: Split plugin declarations
options.body: Land the generic MCP Apps host separately and decide the plugin server attachment API in a focused follow-up.

options.title: Revive typed registration
options.body: Use a plugin SDK registration seam with explicit lifecycle and workspace ownership instead of static manifest objects.

recommendation.title: Approve static declarations
recommendation.body: Keep `mcpServers` with canonical validation, deterministic precedence, disable semantics, documentation, and fresh-install and upgrade compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the broadest relevant cross-surface history and was identified by the prior review as the likely API and security decision owner.
